query: money back for a broken product
information_need: The customer asks for, or reports, a refund or replacement because a product failed.
The customer reports that a charger or charging cable is missing from the order.
The customer says a device does not start or has stopped working and the problem is not yet fixed.
The customer says an order or package has not reached them yet.

query: bank closed my account and is holding my remaining balance
information_need: The company closed or froze the consumer's account and has not returned the money left in it.

query: scammer tricked me into sending money and the app will not refund it
information_need: A scammer persuaded the consumer to send a payment and the company refused to give the money back.
filter_product: Money transfer, virtual currency, or money service

query: late fee charged even though I paid on time
information_need: The company charged a late fee although the consumer says the payment was made on time.

query: escrow payment went up because of insurance or taxes
information_need: The consumer's mortgage escrow or monthly payment rose because of homeowners insurance or property tax amounts.

query: hard inquiry on my credit report I did not authorize
information_need: The consumer disputes a hard credit inquiry that they say they did not authorize.
filter_product: Credit reporting or other personal consumer reports
